integrity: Proof and numerical checker included; symbolic and limiting arguments support continuum assertions; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional reflected diffusion, fixed positive reset site and contact threshold, homogeneous Poisson relocations; no generalization to arbitrary reset locations, finite-sample sensitivity, or non-Poisson clocks. The known stopping-time transform and mean are not claimed as new. Literature-priority comparison is qualified against implicit results in general subordinator theory.
title: Sub-Poisson first-passage uncertainty at the mean-optimal rate for retained boundary contact
